blind.description: An ornate architectural corbel or wall bracket decorated in a sea-storm motif. It features a rectangular flat top shelf with beveled edges, supported by sculpted, swirling wave forms with white crests and foam against a deep turquoise-teal body. A flat vertical back plate allows mounting against a wall. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with glazed ceramic or painted plaster finish.
blind.from_above: A flat turquoise-blue rectangular plate with a faint sheen and a slightly lighter right border, flanked by the tops of white decorative scroll carvings.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 feet tall (around hip height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide.

notes: trident detail in wave motif is soft or indistinct at table distance
